scenario: My friend, who booked the trip with me, got into an argument on the plane and it returned to the gate. We left 8 hours late. Can I claim travel delay?
notes: Delay caused by a travel companion is not covered.

scenario: My flight into Dubai landed late and I missed my connecting flight to Rome. Can I claim for the missed connection?
notes: Wait for the next alternative not stated.

scenario: I got altitude sickness trekking at 4,200 metres in Nepal and needed treatment. Can I claim?
notes: Hiking or trekking above 3,000 m is excluded.

scenario: I got food poisoning in Bali and saw a doctor at a clinic there. Can I claim the bill?
notes: Unexpected illness overseas needing treatment.

scenario: I sprained my ankle in Kuala Lumpur and my cousin, who is a doctor there, treated me and charged me. Can I claim?
notes: Treatment from an interested party (family member) is excluded.

scenario: Two weeks before my trip to Japan, my mother was hospitalised with a life-threatening illness, so I cancelled. I bought the policy two months ago. Can I claim my lost deposits?
notes: Listed event within 30 days of departure; policy bought well before.

scenario: My airline cancelled my flight to Melbourne because of a crew shortage, so I cancelled the whole trip. Can I claim?
notes: Cancellations due to the airline's own fault are excluded.

scenario: My camera and a lens I borrowed from a friend were stolen from my hotel room in Hanoi. I reported it to the police that day. Can I claim for both?
notes: Own camera covered; borrowed lens does not belong to the insured.

scenario: I lost my passport in Seoul. I paid for the replacement and a taxi to the embassy. Can I claim both?
notes: Replacement cost covered; no other expenses are paid.

scenario: My grandmother fell ill a week before my trip, so I cancelled. Can I claim?
notes: Not stated whether the illness was life-threatening (confirmed by a doctor).

scenario: I'm on the MSIG Standard plan. My flight from Singapore to Seoul was delayed 7 hours because of a typhoon. Can I claim?
notes: Poor weather is a listed reason; 6+ hours.

scenario: I'm on the Standard plan and my flight to Osaka was delayed 10 hours. Can I claim?
notes: Reason for the delay not stated; only listed reasons are covered.

scenario: I'm on the Elite plan. I got to the airport after check-in closed, and then the flight itself was delayed 7 hours by bad weather. Can I claim delayed departure?
notes: Failure to check in on time is excluded.

scenario: I'm on the Standard plan. My flight to Perth was diverted to Adelaide because of a passenger's medical emergency, and I arrived 7 hours late. Can I claim?
notes: Medical emergency diversion; 6+ hours.

scenario: I'm on the Standard plan. A necklace I bought on this trip for S$1,200 (I have the receipt) was stolen from my hotel room. I reported it to the police that day. Will I get the full S$1,200?
notes: Jewellery is capped at S$500 in total on Standard.

scenario: My bag was stolen in Bangkok but I only reported it to the police three days later. Can I claim?
notes: Loss not reported within 24 hours of discovery.

scenario: My bag was stolen in Seoul with S$250 of clothes and a transport card with S$40 on it. I reported it to the police the same day. Can I claim both?
notes: Clothes covered; transportation cards excluded.

scenario: I'm on the Elite plan and broke my wrist jet skiing in Bali. Can I claim?
notes: Not stated whether the operator was licensed and safety rules were followed.

scenario: I'm on the Lite plan. My mother was seriously ill (doctor's letter) so I flew home early from Seoul and paid S$250 for a new ticket. Can I claim?
notes: Shortening the trip is covered on Lite, within its S$300 limit.

scenario: My golf clubs were stolen from my hotel in Phuket. Can I claim?
notes: Plan not stated; golfer's cover applies on Elite and Premier only.
